name: RIVL
subtitle: Activity, health, nutrition and training
description: Official RIVL iPhone sideloading preview. Requires recipient Apple signing and seven-day refresh on a free account.

apps.name: RIVL
apps.localizedDescription: Record activity, track health and nutrition, and follow training programs. iPhone-only preview; Watch companion excluded. Health and background GPS need validation after recipient re-signing.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: RIVL connects to your heart-rate strap and power meter to record measured workout data.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: RIVL uses the camera to scan food barcodes.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow RIVL to access your Face ID biometric data.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: RIVL reads your chosen heart rate, HRV, sleep, steps, water and weight data for your health dashboard.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: RIVL can save completed workouts to Apple Health.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RIVL records your route during workouts, including while the screen is locked.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow RIVL to access your location
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RIVL uses GPS to measure your workout.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RIVL uses the microphone when you choose to describe a food.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: RIVL uses motion signals, when you enable automatic start, to distinguish exercise from vehicle travel.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose workout photos or a temporary food reference.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: RIVL transcribes the food you describe so you can review it before logging.
